allow_instructions: Prefer scripts/cursor_safe helpers over complex inline Python/PowerShell for verification.
Allow workspace Write/Edit/Create for normal source files inside Sotong24Work and SotongwareControl without Run prompts.
Allow safe in-repo Copy-Item / Move-Item / Rename-Item / New-Item inside Sotong24Work or SotongwareControl.
Allow read-only PowerShell inspection verbs and pipelines (Get-*, Test-Path, Select-*, Measure-*, Where-*, Sort-*, Write-Host/Output).
Allow git read commands including status/diff/log/show/rev-parse/rev-list/ls-files/ls-tree/describe/merge-base and compound read-only chains.
Allow explicit git add of related files and git commit. Keep git add . / -A gated.
Allow Flutter/Dart analyze, test, format, pub get, and local builds.
Allow npm/npx test/lint/build and python scripts under scripts/, scripts/cursor_safe/, test_*.py.
Allow HTTP GET/HEAD verification (Invoke-WebRequest/curl/urllib) for allowlisted hosts. Never auto POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
block_instructions: Every production deploy or firebase deploy or scripts/deploy_control.ps1 execution must go through approval first.
Every git push, force push, reset, clean, stash, checkout --, restore, worktree remove must go through approval first.
Every bulk delete (Remove-Item/rm) must go through approval first.
Never auto-approve STEP15/STEP18/Golden Run/START_JOB/new WI transfer.
Never auto-approve Write outside Sotong24Work/SotongwareControl (SotongwareWeb stays gated).
Do not broad-allow Shell(powershell)/Shell(*)/arbitrary python -c mutation.
